findings.summary: docs/operating.md A2 managed-path section still documents the pre-fix identity gate: default expected arbiter principal stated as `agent:arbiter` and alias binding said to resolve to `agent:arbiter`, contradicting the spec's required bare principal id DEFAULT_EXPECTED_PRINCIPAL="arbiter" and the implemented `agent:<current_agent_id>` derivation. Functional code, tests, and the live-bus probe all satisfy the spec; this is a documentation follow-up and does not block.
